name: UGC
rootCause: The Education Grants Council (UGC) of India was hacked, the hackers used the Twitter account to post a fake Azuki NFT airdrop link and changed the profile to the Azuki NFT co-creator, replacing the avatar with an Azuki-related image. The agency recovered the account after it was held hostage for six hours.
